meta.title: Our story
meta.description: Meet Adrian and Alondra, the parents behind Tiny Humans: newborn and baby photos at home, anywhere from Miami to Orlando.

hero.title: Hi, we're Adrian & Alondra
hero.intro: We're the husband-and-wife team behind Tiny Humans, and parents ourselves. We bring the studio to your home, so your little one can stay warm, fed and comfy while we capture these first weeks.

story.title: How Tiny Humans started
paragraphs: It started with our own newborn. We wanted those sleepy, curled-up first photos, but we didn't want to pack up a brand-new baby and drive across town to a studio. We looked for a photographer who would come to our home, and we couldn't find one.
Adrian had been behind the camera for about two years, photographing all kinds of things. Once our baby arrived, newborns and little ones became the moments we most wanted to capture.
story.photo: Behind the scenes at a home session

items.title: Baby stays comfy
items.text: Home is where babies feel most at ease: familiar smells and sounds, their own room, and no car seat.

items.title: So do you
items.text: Feed whenever baby wants, change in your own nursery, and skip packing half the house. You don't have to go anywhere.

items.title: All about your family
items.text: Every session goes at baby's pace, with feeding and cuddle breaks built in. We bring the lights, backdrops and props.

people.name: Adrian
people.text: Adrian photographs every session and edits every photo in your gallery.

people.name: Alondra
people.text: Alondra designs each set-up: the backdrops, the wraps, the styling and all the little details.

safety.title: Baby's safety comes first
items: We keep the room warm and cozy.
We wash and sanitize our hands before we hold your baby.
We never use unsupported poses: any tricky pose is a safe composite of two photos.
A parent stays within arm's reach the whole time.

cta.title: We'd love to meet your tiny human
cta.text: Pick a bundle and a time that suits you. $0 today: you pay after your session.
